info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Product Service Agency API
info.description: The Product Service Agency API allows users to access information about product services provided by external agencies. It facilitates retrieving details of specific services based on a provided identifier, enabling seamless integration for businesses looking to enhance their product offerings. Typical consumers include developers within financial institutions and third-party service providers looking to leverage agency services for client solutions. This API streamlines the process of fetching relevant product data, ensuring efficient and effective service delivery.

get.description: This endpoint allows users to fetch detailed information about a specific product service identified by its unique identifier PROD-700045 from the external agency's database.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to retrieve product information from the external agency service. Ensure that the request parameters comply with the expected schema.

200.description: The request was completed successfully, returning the requested product details.
